portfolio_role: Convex credit-crisis hedge and profit center
sizing_context: Historical case: Paulson had tested the trade in April 2005, then built much larger protection positions after research showed the payoff remained highly asymmetric.
sizing_principle: Special-situation convex sizing: define premium loss, buy protection where downside is capped by carry, and press only while the modeled default/refinance thesis remains intact.
risk_capacity_notes: This is not a generic rule to short housing. The setup depended on cheap protection, thin BBB tranches, slowing home-price appreciation, and a research-backed view that zero home-price growth could wipe out the targeted securities. ABX was useful for timing and monitoring after July 2006, not the core reason for the trade.
human_notes: Conviction 5 means full conviction on the 1-5 scale. Raw target weight is not mapped to the user's single-name equity sizing model because this was a historical derivatives/structured-credit trade.
